A true bucket-list meal!|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Gourmet Poultry Curries are made by [[Cooking]] a [[Raw Whole Bird]], [[Goron Spice]], and [[Hylian Rice]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they will heal several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. Prior to the second [[Great Calamity]], these [[Meal]]s were served in [[Hyrule Castle]], and the poultry used in making it is of high quality. By adding more Ingredients, different variations of Gourmet Poultry Curry can be made: * '''Chilly Gourmet Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Gourmet Poultry Curry}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Once served in Hyrule Castle, the poultry used in this dish is of immensely high quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding cold Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] temporarily. * '''Electro Gourmet Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Gourmet Poultry Curry}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Once served in Hyrule Castle, the poultry used in this dish is of immensely high quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Gourmet Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Gourmet Poultry Curry}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Once served in Hyrule Castle, the poultry used in this dish is of immensely high quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. When consumed, they will completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Gourmet Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Gourmet Poultry Curry}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Once served in Hyrule Castle, the poultry used in this dish is of immensely high quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. If eaten, they will replenish a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Gourmet Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Gourmet Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Once served in Hyrule Castle, the poultry used in this dish is of immensely high quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. Link's movement speed is boosted by eating these Curries. * '''Hearty Gourmet Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Gourmet Poultry Curry}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Once served in Hyrule Castle, the poultry used in this dish is of immensely high quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating these Curries will completely heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Gourmet Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Gourmet Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Once served in Hyrule Castle, the poultry used in this dish is of immensely high quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. If eaten, they will boost the power of Link's attacks. * '''Sneaky Gourmet Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Gourmet Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Once served in Hyrule Castle, the poultry used in this dish is of immensely high quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. When Link eats these, he will receive an increase to his [[Stealth]] for a short period of time. * '''Spicy Gourmet Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Gourmet Poultry Curry}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Once served in Hyrule Castle, the poultry used in this dish is of immensely high quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Tough Gourmet Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Gourmet Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Once served in Hyrule Castle, the poultry used in this dish is of immensely high quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients.
